questions.q: What is a Log Analytics workspace?
options: A container in Azure that stores log data so it can be queried in one central place
A type of virtual machine optimized for logging
A free alternative to the Activity Log that replaces it entirely
A dashboard that only shows platform metrics
questions.explain: Logs from VMs, diagnostic settings, and services like Microsoft Sentinel all land in a Log Analytics workspace to be searched together.

questions.q: What is KQL, and where else does it show up?
options: Kusto Query Language — the language used to query a Log Analytics workspace, also used by Microsoft Sentinel
A scripting language exclusive to Azure Resource Manager templates
A deprecated query syntax replaced by SQL
The language used only inside the Azure CLI
questions.explain: KQL is the same query language behind Log Analytics and Microsoft Sentinel, Azure's cloud SIEM.

questions.q: What does the Activity Log record?
options: Control-plane operations against Azure Resource Manager — who did what, and when
Numerical performance data like CPU percentage over time
The contents of files stored in a storage account
SQL query execution plans inside a database
questions.explain: The Activity Log captures administrative actions like creating, modifying, or deleting a resource, including the caller's identity and timestamp.

questions.q: A VM was unexpectedly stopped and no one admits to it. Why can't a metric chart answer who did it, but the Activity Log can?
options: Metrics only show numerical measurements like CPU; the Activity Log records the caller's identity behind administrative actions
Metrics and the Activity Log show exactly the same information
The Activity Log only works if Log Analytics is disabled
Metrics are retained longer than the Activity Log, so they would actually be more useful
questions.explain: Metrics show that the VM is off; the Activity Log shows which account ran the stop operation and when.

questions.q: Is the Activity Log enabled by default, and for how long is it retained?
options: Yes — automatically enabled per subscription at no extra cost, retained 90 days by default
No — it must be purchased as an add-on before it collects any data
Yes, but only for virtual machines, not other resource types
It is retained indefinitely with no option to route it elsewhere
questions.explain: Every subscription gets the Activity Log automatically, retained 90 days by default, though it can be routed to a workspace or storage for longer retention.
